title: Unknown discount code makes /quote multiply by None

provenance.modeled_on: regression from a shared helper to a raw dict lookup without default; the sentinel None flows into arithmetic (Yuan et al. 2014's mishandled-error shape)

mutations.find:
rate = discount_rate(code)
    total = unit * quantity * (1 - rate)
mutations.replace:
rate = DISCOUNTS.get(code)
    total = unit * quantity * (1 - rate)

notes: the flagship stateless fault; first real heal used this shape
